cohort: 180 neonate-mother pairs registered/admitted to Punakha District Hospital between 2019 and 2020.
finding: Medical problems during pregnancy, neonatal complications, maternal B and O blood groups, and vaginal birth were significantly associated with neonatal jaundice.
mod_finding: Neonates born via caesarean section were 92% less likely to get jaundice compared with their vaginally born counterparts.
